readback.name: Poincare.DeTurckCoupledForcing.tensorJet_hasFDerivAt
readback.mathematical_statement: Let E be the fixed real three-dimensional Euclidean space ClosedSmoothModel 3 = EuclideanSpace R (Fin 3), with its Euclidean norm and real normed-space structure. Let Bilin = E ->L[R] E ->L[R] R be the full space of continuous bilinear forms represented as curried continuous linear maps, with the corresponding nested operator norms, and let Jet1 = E ->L[R] Bilin. The pinned coupled-forcing definitions give Jet1 the usual continuous-linear-map normed additive group and real normed-space instances. The contract has no universe variables or manifold type parameter. For every pair of real numbers alpha,T, every W : Inputs alpha T, every real t, and every z : E, if 0 <= t <= T, the spatial function y |-> tensorValue W (t,y) has the real Frechet derivative tensorJet W (t,z) at z. Alpha and T are arbitrary real numbers; there is no hypothesis 0 < alpha < 1, 0 < T, or T <= 1. For T < 0 the time-membership premise is empty. For T = 0 it includes t = 0. Inputs alpha T is the finite Pi space (Fin 3 times Fin 3) -> ParabolicSolutionGraph.Graph alpha T. Thus W supplies nine independent ordered scalar Graph components W(a,b), with the original finite Pi maximum norm. Each Graph contains the actual scalar carriers u,ut, the spatial covector carrier du, and the spatial second-derivative carrier ddu in the pinned Y spaces. A Y carrier is a bounded function on R times E, zero off Icc 0 T times E, together with bounded scaled parabolic differences on distinct pairs in that cylinder. Its norm is the sum of its value and scaled-difference sup norms. The Graph norm is the sum of the four Y norms. Graph includes zero initial u trace, the ambient spatial derivative certificate HasFDerivAt (y |-> u(t,y)) (du(t,z)) z for every t in Icc 0 T and every z : E, the corresponding ambient spatial derivative certificate for du with derivative ddu, and a time derivative certificate HasDerivWithinAt relative to Icc 0 T. For a,b : Fin 3, coordinate a is the real continuous linear coordinate functional of the actual Euclidean basis basis3. The pinned tensor a b is (coordinate a).smulRight (coordinate b), so tensor a b applied to v,w equals coordinate a(v) times coordinate b(w). TensorValue W (t,y) is exactly the sum over all a,b of W(a,b).u(t,y) acting by real scalar multiplication on tensor a b. TensorJet W (t,z) is exactly the sum over all a,b of the continuous linear map W(a,b).du(t,z).smulRight(tensor a b). Consequently its action on a spatial direction h : E is the sum over all a,b of W(a,b).du(t,z)(h) acting by real scalar multiplication on tensor a b. The derivative direction is the outer E slot; the two bilinear tensor slots follow it. All nine ordered tensor components and all three spatial direction components are retained, without a symmetry premise or identification of off-diagonal slots. The conclusion is HasFDerivAt over the whole ambient E at fixed t, even when t is a time endpoint. It is not a derivative restricted to a chart target or a within-cylinder spatial derivative. Its derivative is the actual continuous linear map tensorJet W (t,z), rather than an arbitrary witness or a totalized fderiv expression. The carrier membership and component Graph.hasFDeriv certificates are the only supplied spatial differentiability data. This statement reconstructs their first spatial derivative into a Bilin-valued derivative certificate. Time or joint derivatives, differentiated coefficients, covariance, estimates, a forcing operator, and geometric flow production are outside this conclusion.
